propositions: On first upgrade (store file absent), existing managed links with bound targets must be backfilled as confirmed records with source=backfill and direction=backfill, preventing the post-upgrade pass from wrongly declining legitimate peer deletions
Backfill must not re-run once the store file exists, even if empty, and must check existing records before writing to avoid downgrading stronger provenance (push/snapshot) to backfill

The evidence step must use a single store instance opened once, with backfill running first then snapshot confirmation on the same instance, ensuring backfilled records are visible and no lost-update race condition occurs
Managed refs with unbound targets receive no backfill record, and is_confirmed() treats backfilled records as confirmed
Backfill respects the no-write mode (persist=False) and fail-open exception handling without breaking the pass
